inspiration.observed: Simple navigation, strong restaurant branding, branch photography, addresses, hours, map links and external ordering.

inspiration.observed: Client-rendered ordering application; source metadata emphasizes deals and delivery. Full interactive flow could not be established from fetched HTML.
